description: A preset the server does not offer is refused even for a request its content fits: a plain domain read under the epp preset where the server has none, and under the rri profile.
comment: Skipped on rri-mtest: MTEST's config signals the preset by media type; the twin in preset_signalling_media_type/ covers it.

steps.comment: Reads domain b3, with Content-Type application/rpp+json, Accept application/rpp+json, RPP-Preset preset=urn:ietf:params:rpp:preset:epp-compatible;version=1.0; expects 400 02004. An error answer this case checks. Only where the server offers no epp-compatible preset (rri-mtest).

Reads domain b3, with Content-Type application/rpp+json, Accept application/rpp+json, RPP-Preset preset=de.denic.rpp.preset.rri;version=1.0; expects 400 02004. The error answer this case checks. Only where the server offers no rri preset (epp-docker).
